REMOVE_VPK_CONTENT.name: Remove Base Game Content
REMOVE_VPK_CONTENT.description: Removes all content from the input folder which are already included in the selected game's base content. (VPKs)

DEDUPLICATE_VTF.name: Remove Duplicate VTFs
DEDUPLICATE_VTF.description: Collects all duplicate VTF images into a shared directory and redirects VMTs to that single VTF image.

FIT_ALPHA_VTF.name: Fit Alpha
FIT_ALPHA_VTF.description: Strip unnecessary channels from VTF images, fitting their formats as exactly as possible.

REMOVE_REDUNDANT_CONTENT.name: Remove Redundant Files
REMOVE_REDUNDANT_CONTENT.description: Removes files unused by both modern engine branches and modding tools.

parameters.label: Remove Files from Input Folder
parameters.tip: Deletes redundant files from the input folder instead of moving useful files to the output folder.

SHRINK_SOLID_VTF.name: Shrink Solid Colour VTFs
SHRINK_SOLID_VTF.description: Shrinks all solid-colour VTFs to a minimum resolution, keeping its usage identical but filesize minimal. Encodes a flag to skip already-shrunk images.

parameters.label: Override Flags
parameters.tip: Attempts to processes VTFs which have already had their flags set.

REMOVE_UNACCESSED_VTF.name: Remove Unaccessed VTFs
REMOVE_UNACCESSED_VTF.description: Removes all VTF files not referenced by any VMT in the input folder.
REMOVE_UNACCESSED_VTF.warning: This will remove VTF images referenced only in code.

parameters.label: Remove VTFs from Input Folder
parameters.tip: Deletes unaccessed VTFs instead of moving them to the output.

OPTIMIZE_PNG.name: Optimize PNGs
OPTIMIZE_PNG.description: Optimizes PNG images and strips unnecessary metadata.

parameters.label: PNG Compression
parameters.tip: Higher is slower, but smaller and better-quality.

STEREO_TO_MONO_WAV.name: Stereo WAV to Mono
STEREO_TO_MONO_WAV.description: Maps all stereo WAVs' two channels to a single mono channel, halving filesize. May fix broken directionality, such as all sounds having a uniform volume in both ears regardless of directionality.

parameters.label: Remove stereo WAVs from Input Folder
parameters.tip: Deletes stereo WAVs from the input folder instead of moving the mono WAVs to the output folder.

SHRINK_NORMAL_VTF.name: Shrink Normals
SHRINK_NORMAL_VTF.description: Shrinks the dimensions of all normal map VTF images. Encodes a flag to skip already-shrunk images.

parameters.label: Override fOptimizer Flags
parameters.tip: Attempts to processes VTFs which have already had their flags set.

parameters.label: Multiplier
parameters.tip: The amount of times to shrink each normal by (2x = half, 4x = quarter). Must be a power of 2.

parameters.label: Clamp Width
parameters.tip: The minimum width in pixels a shrunk VTF can be.

parameters.label: Clamp Height
parameters.tip: The minimum height in pixels a shrunk VTF can be.

WAV_TO_OGG.name: WAV to OGG
WAV_TO_OGG.description: Converts all WAV files to OGG files for large filesize reduction.
WAV_TO_OGG.warning: All references to WAV files in code and on maps must be manually updated to fit the OGG extension.

parameters.label: OGG Quality
parameters.tip: Higher is slower, but results in smaller and better-quality.

parameters.label: Remove WAVs from Input Folder
parameters.tip: Deletes WAVs from the input folder instead of moving the OGGs to the output folder.
